findings.description: The harness file campaign_cases.py was rewritten on disk (RC2C c8add78f -> RC2D d933206f) while campaign35 was running. campaign35's rows were produced and replayed by the orchestrator's already-imported RC2C module (its ignite_tnt rows carry requires={'vision':5} only), but its EVIDENCE_HASHES.json / MANIFEST evidenceHashes record the RC2D hash, and the RC2C campaign_cases.py is no longer on disk. I reconstructed it exactly (current file minus the ignite_tnt requires hunk = c8add78f), so no verdict changes. Still, the recorded provenance for campaign35 is wrong, and the frozen harness was edited mid-campaign.

The shelf transfer is an item-in-hand action (main='stick'), but it has neither offhand_* rows nor NA_OFFHAND_NOT_APPLICABLE rows. It drops out of the offhand pass only because the harness excludes the whole ability open_chest by name, and no rationale is recorded. The vanilla ShelfBlock bytecode suggests the shelf ignores the off hand, so I do not treat this as a coverage gap, but the package should state it.
